Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 78  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Calvin Coolidge was born in "Plymouth, Massachusetts" instead of the correct location, which is "Plymouth Notch, Vermont." This error occurred due to two issues: (1) failure to critically evaluate the evidence provided by WebSurfer and other agents and (2) conflating information between sources. Although Britannica indicated "Plymouth, Vermont" as the general location, the Vermont State Historic Site explicitly confirmed "Plymouth Notch" as the precise birthplace, which the Planner neglected to acknowledge. The error likely reflects an oversight in properly synthesizing the data retrieved by WebSurfer and an unverified assumption equating "Plymouth" with "Plymouth, Massachusetts." This indicates a failure in critical fact-checking before declaring the task complete.
